name: @jsquash/gif
description: Wasm GIF decoder supporting the browser. Decode GIF images to ImageData.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && cp -r codec package.json README.md .npmignore ../../LICENSE dist && cd dist/codec
scripts.prepublishOnly: [[ "$PWD" == *'/dist' ]] && exit 0 || (echo 'Please run npm publish from the dist directory' && exit 1)
